why: The loliconsunite sign item mixes ongoing repair and rebuilding with urgent calls to defend against attacks, so deciding whether upkeep or attack response leads is delicate.

why.T3-156: The joke is about changing the community logo to match the canvas pixels, which is taking the canvas mark into the sub's identity as an emblem.

why.T3-073: It is a retrospective account of the room's canvas effort and missed participation, closest to reporting how the work or effort fared after the fact rather than marking the canvas end itself.

why.T3-187: The item is about continuity and handing responsibility to keepers: asking who began, praising those keeping it alive, hoping and agreeing to keep it going, so it is handing the work over rather than crediting or celebrating.

why.T3-011: Members describe sending effort to other communities' works, first Funhaus and then Corridor, with nothing asked in return, so it is helping another room's work rather than recruiting or joining an outside build.

why.T3-080: The passages center on the sign's contested meaning and acceptability: critics condemn it and members ask respect or peace, so it is arguing over the symbol rather than simply repairing or defending pixels.

why.T3-073: The passages tell what happened or would have happened to the work after the close, being spared by the ending or seen being ruined, so it is reporting the work's fate rather than blaming a loss or celebrating.

why.T3-021: Most concepts are upkeep, blueprint sharing, clearing and rebuilding, and returning on timers to keep the signs present; the maintenance and repair side leads.
why.T3-005: Distinct concepts are urgent calls to defend during attacks and reports of attacks or successful defence, which T3-021's repair gate does not carry.

multiplacement_log.why_not_one: A single T3-021 placement would cover upkeep and repair but fail to carry the under-attack alarms and calls to defend or fight that are a distinct part of this material.
multiplacement_log.why_this_one: C1219703, C0275541, C0581171 and C0817499 are calls to defend during an attack, and C1288797 reports a successful defence, satisfying T3-005's attack-and-answer gate.
multiplacement_log.dispensable: T3-005; dropping it would lose the attack and defence dimension, leaving only upkeep and rebuilding.
